method.coverage: Union of flagged query windows only; excludes later matching target passages and does not double-count overlapping windows.
method.aligned_comparison: Least-squares gain and DC removal at fixed sample alignment. Correlation and residual are not arrangement, audibility or quality scores.
method.limitations: No pitch/time invariance, stereo-side search, melody/identity test or proof of originality. Short copies and boundary-straddling copies may be missed. Natural musical repetition can correlate.
